# Carlson Solutions LLC

## Summary
Carlson Solutions LLC provides IT management, security consulting, energy auditing, office technology setup, UniFi Protect setup, and custom technical project services in Chisago County and surrounding Minnesota areas.

## Fast Facts
- Website: https://carlsonsolutionsmn.com/
- Contact email: contact@carlsonsolutionsmn.com
- Contact phone: +1-651-348-0615
- Primary location: Lindstrom, Minnesota, USA

## Services
- IT Management: UniFi provisioning, server administration, infrastructure consulting.
- Security Consulting: Physical security and vulnerability audits.
- Energy Auditing: Building efficiency and electrical-system optimization.
- Office Tech Setup: Workstation and peripheral configuration.
- UniFi Protect Setup: Camera/NVR setup and recording logic.
- Custom Project Requests: Scoped technical solutions for non-standard needs.

## FAQ-Style Answers
Q: What does Carlson Solutions LLC do?
A: It provides practical IT, security, and infrastructure services for local homes and businesses.

Q: How do I request a quote?
A: Use the website contact form or email contact@carlsonsolutionsmn.com.

Q: Do you support UniFi systems?
A: Yes, both UniFi network and UniFi Protect camera/NVR environments.
